controls: Ordinary completion and explicit cancellation retain zero completed task handles in both variants. Their signed allocator differences are small and noisy; no general performance improvement is inferred.
limits: Heap samples are allocator live-byte deltas for an extracted-method component, including runtime and scheduler allocations; they are not whole-player memory or RSS.
All callback capture probes were destroyed before settled sampling. Completed task-handle retention does not establish retained decoder or media payloads.
Synthetic timing includes actor/lifetime barriers and a common quiet interval; it does not establish playback or renderer throughput.
Native macOS renderer, subtitle, and physical worker behavior is outside this audit and requires the dedicated integration tests.
The candidate was built from a local worktree; exact source hashes, not the worktree HEAD alone, identify the measured implementation.
An earlier sandboxed attempt failed before measurements; this audit covers the separately completed unsandboxed run. Environment diagnostics are preserved separately.
native_integration_status: Pending macOS integration; this Linux component audit does not establish native qualification.

physical_stop_32768.interpretation: Zero completed handles does not mean zero registry bytes. Clearing the empty candidate registry releases capacity retained after the peak simultaneous physical waits; storage is related to active-work high water rather than accumulating completed handles.

scope: Independent arithmetic, semantic-count and source-provenance audit of the completed Linux component experiment.
